title: 给我整个图书管理员
description:
Godot XR Gamejam

This week is the voting week of Godot XR Gamejam 2025. I saw a lot good works.

  • Your Hand Is A Dragon (XR), your hand is a flying dragon.
  • A Wizards Way, XR puzzle game.
  • The Chant of Cthulhu, I single person choir.
  • Agni Kairo: VR Firebending, workout game.
  • Sweep Stakes VR, VR flying broom.
  • High Alchemist VR, cooking game.

I saw a video which talks about using zotero library and OpenWebUI and Ollama to build an agent base on your own database. I think it is super helpful.

I think this is not the first time I use it. This time I used it to export some unity 3D model. Because I need to test some model in mixamo. However, I still have to transpile it into fbx using this website.
